title: Clock rate and acceleration from rest of a body with position-dependent factors

key_results.statement: Weak records, exact on the chain $\lvert x\rvert\le L$ for every member, start and $\lambda$: body expectations differ from those of $e^{-iC_{\rm eff}\lambda}\phi$ by at most $2\kappa^2\sigma_X^2L^2\lambda^2\lVert O\rVert$.
Velocity operator of the class: $\mathrm d\bar x_{\rm lab}/\mathrm d\lambda=\langle\hat v\rangle$ with $\hat v=-\frac{\tau}{2}\sum_x\zeta_x(R_x+R_x^\dagger)\otimes\sigma_1$, exact for every $\kappa$.

Acceleration operator: $\hat a=\frac{\tau^2}{2}\sum_x(\zeta_x^2-\zeta_{x-1}^2)P_x+\frac{\tau}{2}\sum_x\zeta_x[(R_x+R_x^\dagger)\sigma_2(\mathsf M_x+\mathsf M_{x+1})+(V_{x+1}-V_x)(-iR_x+iR_x^\dagger)\sigma_1]$, with end terms on the open chain.

Exact second derivative for every $\kappa$: $\mathrm d^2\bar x_{\rm lab}/\mathrm d\lambda^2=\langle\hat a\otimes 1+\kappa A_\zeta\otimes(X-\langle X\rangle)\rangle$; the second term is $0$ at $\lambda=0$ and at most $2\kappa^2\sigma_X^2\tau\zeta_{\max}L\lambda$ later.
For $S_k$ and $S'_k$, exactly: $\mathrm d\bar x_{\rm lab}/\mathrm d\lambda(0)=0$ and $\mathrm d^2\bar x_{\rm lab}/\mathrm d\lambda^2(0)=\frac{\tau^2}{2}\sum_x(\zeta_x^2-\zeta_{x-1}^2)\phi_X(x)^2$.

First-order acceleration of the start $S_k$ at finite $W$ on the infinite chain: $a^{(1)}_W(\lambda)=\langle\alpha(p,\lambda)\rangle_W$ with $\alpha$ smooth, even in $p$ and independent of $x_0$; the zeroth order vanishes.

Wide-start limit at fixed $\lambda$: $a^{(1)}_\infty(\lambda)=\tau^2g_\zeta\cos(2M_k\lambda)+\frac{2\tau^2}{M_k}(\mathcal F-G_k)\sin^2(M_k\lambda)-2\tau^2G_k\lambda\sin(2M_k\lambda)$, $G_k=mg_m+d_kg_\eta$.

Finite width: $\lvert a^{(1)}_W-a^{(1)}_\infty\rvert\le\frac{\pi^2}{8}\delta_W^2\sup_p\lvert\partial_p^2\alpha\rvert$ (exact) with $\sup_p\lvert\partial_p^2\alpha\rvert\le c\,\tau b_1(1+M_k\lambda)(1+\tau\lambda)^3$ (order estimate) and $\delta_W^2=O(W^{-2})$.

Wide-start first-order velocity: $v^{(1)}_\infty=\frac{\tau^2}{M_k}(\mathcal F-G_k)\lambda+\frac{\tau^2G_k}{M_k}\lambda\cos(2M_k\lambda)+\frac{\tau^2}{2M_k^2}(M_kg_\zeta-\mathcal F)\sin(2M_k\lambda)$.

Window average with the wide start first: $\overline{a^{(1)}_\infty}=\frac{\tau^2}{M_k}[(\mathcal F-G_k)+G_k\varsigma+(M_kg_\zeta-\mathcal F)\rho]$; $\varsigma=\cos(2M_kT)+O(\lambda_1/\Lambda)$ does not decay, so the coefficients of $g_m$, $g_\eta$ have no long-window limit.

Additional result: secular acceleration $a_{\rm sec}:=\frac{\tau^2}{M_k}(\mathcal F-G_k)$, the coefficient of $\frac12\lambda^2$ in the wide-start first-order displacement; it is not the window average of item 2(b).

Exact second-order remainder on any chain (open ends included) within $\ell$ of the expansion point, if $b_1\ell\le\tau+M_k$: $\lvert a-a^{(0)}_\ell-a^{(1)}_\ell\rvert\le16\,\tau(\tau+M_k)[b_1\ell(\lambda+(\tau+M_k)^{-1})]^2$ for all $\lambda\ge0$.

Well-defined form with the wide start first: $\overline{a^{(1)}_\infty}=\frac{8t^2}{\Delta_k}[-\delta E^+_k+\frac12\delta\Delta_k\varsigma+(\frac{\Delta_k}{2}\frac{\delta t}{t}+\frac12(\delta E^+_k+\delta E^-_k))\rho]$, and $a_{\rm sec}=\lim_{W\to\infty}\bar a_W=-\frac{8t^2}{\Delta_k}\delta E^+_k$.

Other branch $S'_k$, wide start: $a'^{(1)}_\infty$ is (3.11) with $\mathcal F\to-\mathcal F$ in the $\sin^2$ term, and $a'_{\rm sec}=-\frac{\tau^2}{M_k}(\mathcal F+G_k)=+\frac{8t^2}{\Delta_k}\delta E^-_k$ (additional result).
Additional result, limits $W\to\infty$ of $\bar a_W$ for the variants: (a) $-g\tau^2$; (b1) $-g\tau^2m/(m+d_k)$; (b2) $-g\tau^2d_k/(m+d_k)$; (c) $-g\tau^2$; (d) $\tau^2\mathcal F/(m+d_k)$.

Uniform profiles: $q(a;\lambda)=P_N(a;\Gamma_\ast(p_0)\eta_\ast\lambda/\lambda_0)+\mathcal R_\ast$ with $\Gamma_\ast=\bar\mu_\ast/\sqrt{\bar\mu_\ast^2+\tau^2\zeta_\ast^2\sin^2p_0}$, $\bar\mu_\ast=m_\ast+\eta_\ast\bar d$.
Tick for uniform profiles: $\lambda_\ast(p_0)=\lambda_0/(\eta_\ast\Gamma_\ast(p_0))$ and $\lambda_\ast(0)=\lambda_0/\eta_\ast$, independent of $m_\ast$, $\zeta_\ast$, $V_\ast$.

Linear profiles, start $S_{\rm clock}(x_0)$, every real $w$, exact: $\lvert q(a;\lambda)-P_N(a;\eta_{x_0}\lambda/\lambda_0)\rvert\le\delta_W^2\frac{\tau^{0\,2}}{m_{x_0}^2}(2+\frac{\pi\eta_{x_0}\lambda}{\lambda_0})+2b_{\rm cl}\lambda(W+\frac12+\frac12\tau^0\lambda)+4e^{\theta_0}\theta_0^r/r!+2\kappa^2\sigma_X^2L^2\lambda^2$.
Rate at $x_0$: $\mathrm d\vartheta_{x_0}/\mathrm d\lambda=\eta_{x_0}/\lambda_0=\frac{N}{2\pi}(E^+_{x_0,k+1}-E^+_{x_0,k})$; tick $\lambda_0/\eta_{x_0}$.
Ratio of rates at two places, compared at equal $\lambda$ (A8): $\eta_{x_1}/\eta_{x_2}=(1+g_\eta x_1)/(1+g_\eta x_2)$; $(1+gx_1)/(1+gx_2)$ in (a), (b2), (c) and $1$ in (b1), (d).

For the acceleration of item 2(a) and its window average at finite $W$ or with the wide start first, no variant is the same for all $k$ and $m$; in the iterated limit $\Lambda\to\infty$ then $W\to\infty$ only (a) and (c) have both a window average independent of $k$, $m$ ($-g\tau^2$) and a place-dependent clock rate.

Exact structure of the first-order velocity density: $\nu(p,\lambda)=a_{\rm sec}(p)\lambda+\nu_0(p)+\operatorname{Re}\sum_{j\le2}\lambda^jA_j(p)e^{2i\omega_k\lambda}$ with $a_{\rm sec}(p)=\frac{g_\zeta\tau^4\sin^2p-G_k\tau^2M_k\cos2p}{\omega_k^2}+\mathcal F\frac{\tau^2M_k(M_k^2\cos2p-\tau^2\sin^4p)}{\omega_k^4}$ and $A_2\propto\mathcal F\omega_k'$.

At every finite $W$ the long-window limit of the window average exists: $\bar a_W=\langle a_{\rm sec}(p)\rangle_W=g_\zeta\tau^4s_W-\frac{\tau^2G_k}{M_k}[1-(2M_k^2+\tau^2)s_W]+\frac{\tau^2\mathcal F}{M_k}f_W$, with $0<s_W\le\delta_W^2/M_k^2$ and $0\le1-f_W\le2(M_k^2+\tau^2)s_W$.

$\lvert\bar a_W-a_{\rm sec}\rvert\le2\delta_W^2\frac{\tau^2}{M_k}(1+\frac{\tau^2}{M_k^2})b_1$ (exact), so $\lim_{W\to\infty}\lim_{\Lambda\to\infty}\overline{a^{(1)}_W}=a_{\rm sec}$, while $\lim_{\Lambda\to\infty}\lim_{W\to\infty}$ does not exist for $G_k\neq0$: the limits do not commute.

Well-defined form at finite $W$: $\bar a_W=16t^3\delta t\,s_W-\frac{4t^2}{\Delta_k}\delta\Delta_k[1-(\frac12\Delta_k^2+4t^2)s_W]-\frac{4t^2}{\Delta_k}(\delta E^+_k+\delta E^-_k)f_W$, in gaps, hopping norms and neighbour differences of on-site eigenvalues.
Other branch $S'_k$ at finite $W$, long window: $\bar a'_W=g_\zeta\tau^4s_W-\frac{\tau^2G_k}{M_k}[1-(2M_k^2+\tau^2)s_W]-\frac{\tau^2\mathcal F}{M_k}f_W$; only the $\mathcal F$ term changes sign.

Variants, $\bar a_W$ for $S_k$: (a) $-g\tau^2(1-u_W)$; (b1) $-g\tau^2\frac{m}{M_k}(1-u_W)$; (b2) $-g\tau^2\frac{d_k}{M_k}(1-u_W)$; (c) $-g\tau^2(1-u^{\rm c}_W)$; (d) $\frac{\tau^2\mathcal F}{M_k}f_W$, with $u_W=(2M_k^2+\tau^2)s_W$, $u^{\rm c}_W=2(M_k^2+\tau^2)s_W$.

Absolute error of the double average: $\lvert2[\bar x^{(1)}_{\rm lab}(\Lambda)-\bar x_{\rm lab}(0)]/\Lambda^2-a_{\rm sec}\rvert\le\frac{\tau^2\lvert G_k\rvert}{M_k^2\Lambda}+\frac{\tau^2\lvert M_kg_\zeta-\mathcal F-G_k\rvert}{M_k^3\Lambda^2}$.
Even $w$ and a chain symmetric about $x_0$: $q$ is even in the gradients jointly (exact), and $\lvert q-q_{\rm loc}\rvert\le c[b_{\rm cl}\lambda(W+1+\tau_{\max}\lambda)]^2$ (order estimate).

open_issues: The amplitudes ν_0, A_0, A_1 of (3.26) are not given in closed form for p ≠ 0, and the rate at which the window average reaches (3.27) is an order estimate (Λ ≫ λ_W); the constant c_W is not determined.

(3.27) and (3.14) are statements about the first Taylor coefficient; the range (3.16) is a sufficient condition, the sharp range is not determined, and the growing oscillation beyond first order (|G_k| W λ not small) is not derived here.
For variant (a) the dependence of the finite-W average on M_k is shown to be present for wide starts only (order estimate); for variant (c) it is exact for every start.
Clock corrections: second-order coefficients are computed only at τ = 0 (width) and for variant (d) (motion); for the other cases the stated powers are upper bounds, not shown to be attained.
For unbounded bond profiles the limit of a long chain is not shown.
The rates at two places are compared across two runs through A8; a comparison inside one description is not treated.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions (unit 1/λ² for accelerations and the remainder (3.16), 1/λ for rates, none for the clock bounds) and the case of zero gradients: Model D operators of (6.12), vanishing (3.11) and (3.27), P_N(a; λ/λ0), ratio 1.

Variant (d) against (6.12), (6.13), (6.24), (6.15), (6.20): operators, 2τ²F sin²(M_k λ)/M_k and average τ²F(1−ρ)/M_k agree; both orders of the limits give τ²F/M_k; the branch values σFω'' of (3.26) agree with the exact shift of the plane-wave label in (9.1).

Independent derivation of the three coefficients of (3.26) from the branch function E_σ(p,x) with ẋ = ∂E/∂p, ṗ = −∂E/∂x; p = 0 gives (3.15); for τ → 0 the accelerations vanish as τ² and the clock formula becomes the exact mixture over places.
